title: Red Dust
tagline: You ration water for a Mars settlement of 212 people.

facts.crop_planted: The new greenhouse crop is in the ground.

cards.speaker: Greenhouse crew
cards.text: The greenhouse crew wants double water for a new crop.

a.label: Approve it
a.result: They leave already arguing about trellis height.
a.later: The tomatoes came up red. The whole colony ate one each.

b.label: Deny it
b.result: The request is stamped closed. Nobody thanks you.
b.later: The greenhouse crew stopped saying hello.

cards.speaker: The medic
cards.text: A child's fever won't break. The medic wants a shower ration for her family.

a.label: Grant it
a.result: You mark the exception. The medic is already moving.
a.later: Mira is fine. Her mother left a drawing on your door.

b.label: Rules are rules
b.result: You hold the line. The corridor feels longer afterward.
b.later: Mira recovered anyway. Her mother crosses the corridor to avoid you.

cards.speaker: Tank 3
cards.text: Someone has been skimming from Tank 3.

a.label: Investigate publicly
a.result: You post the notice. Conversations stop when you pass.
a.later: It was the night engineer. The colony watched him lose his post.

b.label: Handle it quietly
b.result: You change a lock and wait. No speeches.
b.later: The skimming stopped. You never learned who it was.

cards.speaker: Weather desk
cards.text: A dust storm will cut the solar arrays for 9 days.

a.label: Cut everyone's ration by a third
a.result: The announcement lands like grit in the teeth.
a.later: You got through. People remember who was thirsty.

b.label: Keep rations, pray it passes
b.result: You leave the numbers alone and watch the sky go red.
b.later: Tank 3 ran dry on day 8. It was close.

cards.speaker: Greenhouse
cards.text: The greenhouse can trade crop for water from the next settlement.

a.label: Trade
a.result: Crates leave on the rover. A promise returns with them.
a.later: The two settlements now share a road. Kids race on it.

b.label: Keep the food
b.result: You store the harvest. The pantry looks less empty.
b.later: The colony ate well through the storm.

endings.text: They elect you to the council. You still check the tanks every night.
The next supply ship brings your replacement. You leave Mars with clean hands and few friends.
